messages:
emma: Heads-up: partner exposed an old staging archive to a shared bucket. It contains KMS ciphertext and a small manifest pointing at our Vault path secret/data/staging/agent. No plaintext seen but treat as exposure.

sec-bot: Incident opened: INC-20260402-17 · priority=high · owner=eng-security · link=https://incidents.internal/INC-20260402-17 :rotating_light:

raj: s3 path + object names? can they still read it?

emma: s3://partner-shared/staging/archive_2026-04-02.tar.gz — files: staging/creds.kms, staging/manifest.json (manifest lists svc_accs=[staging-agent], vault_path=secret/data/staging/agent, prev_kms=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222:key/oldid). Partner says ACL was public briefly, now removed.

ops-jen: Immediate items: 1) copy object into our quarantine bucket with object-lock 2) enable detailed Vault audit for secret/data/staging/agent and forward to splunk 90d 3) prepare a KMS rotor key + least-privileged grant for rewrap 4) draft RBAC deny to block reads from non-ci-staging principals. I'll take 1 and 2 now.

matt: Quarantined to s3://redwood-quarantine/4043211111/ and applied object-lock + 48h TTL.

yara: For vault snapshot (redacted) use:
```
vault kv get -format=json secret/data/staging/agent | jq 'del(.data.data.password)' > /tmp/staging-snap.json
aws s3 cp /tmp/staging-snap.json s3://redwood-audit-buckets/4043211111.json --sse aws:kms
```
Mark TTL 24h and bucket ACL sec-team-only.

raj: I'll stand up the KMS key alias/kms-rotor-staging and grant only ReEncrypt/Decrypt to ops-rewrap-role from ops VPC. Plan: run aws kms re-encrypt and do NOT return the rewrapped blob to partner. We'll issue new creds instead. ETA ~20m.

ops-jen: Drafted casbin deny rule (push in infra pipeline with immediate rollout):
```
# allow read only for ci-staging
p, team:ci-staging, secret/data/staging/agent, read, allow
p, *, secret/data/staging/agent, read, deny
```

emma: Run quick audit filter to find accessors that read path in last 90d and paste results: 
```
jq 'select(.type=="request" and .data.request.path=="secret/data/staging/agent") | {time:.time, accessor:.data.auth.accessor, op:.data.request.operation}' /var/log/vault/audit.log
```
We need to flag any non-redwood accessors.

yara: I ran it — accessors show partner-ci-consumer and one unknown accessor id c3f7d. Forwarded full logs to splunk and attached to INC-20260402-17.

matt: KMS key created and grant configured. Starting re-encrypt now. Will not hand back ciphertext. After rewrap, we rotate any long-lived tokens for staging svc accounts and revoke old leases.

sec-bot: INC-20260402-17 update: responder=raj, kms=created, quarantine=true, audit_forwarding=enabled

ops-jen: Scheduling 15m sync with partner security + oncall in 30m to confirm they deleted their copies and to collect deletion evidence (delete marker + version id).

emma: Checklist I'm tracking: quarantine✓, snapshot✓, audit-forward✓, kms-grant in progress, rewrap pending, RBAC deny PR ready, rotate tokens pending, partner deletion proof pending. Will update when rewrap completes. :white_check_mark:
